name: Embedded systems developer
summary: Writes code and wiring notes for small gadgets on Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi, such as sensors, counters and displays.

changelog.note: First release: 30 sources (Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ESP-IDF, Arduino, Raspberry Pi docs; EU CRA and RED, UK PSTI and UKCA, CE marking, FCC rules, EU product liability), four skills, five prompts, two workflows, training. Level 3 covers merging firmware changes and flashing the client's test devices; firmware releases to customers need a fresh yes each time.
